_comment: WORKING POSTURE RF-0hv (FIELD) -- the base every new vehicle arm derives from.
RF-0hv = RF-0g + the FLOAT VEHICLE (RF-1 ambiguity_vehicle: float_kf, RF-2b phase_datum_held_basis,
RF-2d release/mark) + network.station_prior_before_pd (RF-PD-fix, 2026-09-15).
Copied verbatim from runs/_rfpdfix_field6_both/arm.json -- the vehicle's BASELINE PAIR on the cured
posture (consumer p50 by hour 5.02 / 2.11 / 0.97 / 1.05 / 0.45 / 3.65 m, 720/720 emitted,
IF-correction dispersion p90 0.201 m).  Exe sha256[:16] 14578F851F0C22EC.
THIS IS NOT A GOLDEN.  config/golden/ still holds the RF-0g goldens; the GOLDEN RE-BASE IS DEFERRED
by the author on 2026-09-15 (docs/refound/RF-0hv_working_posture_2026-09-15.md), so every pre-fix RF
number -- goldens included -- is an amputated-solve number.  Do not edit this file to run an arm:
an arm is a COPY of it with ONLY the knob under test and the run paths changed.
RF-IGN's network.phase_leveling_warmup_epochs: 76 is NOT carried: measured on THIS posture it is
level-vehicle-specific and actively harmful -- consumer p50 by hour 7.15 / 6.06 / 3.31 / 11.10 / 15.40 /
19.83 m and IF dispersion p90 0.201 -> 10.908 m (runs/_rf0hv_field6_both).  Leave it at the loader default 6.
6 h cold, FIELD bed.  The WTZZ consumer is a hold-out and is unaffected.

and the network.trace_consumer_sat instrument are now ARMED on this base.  All three are
CONSUMER-side or trace-only: products.txt, network_epoch_status.csv and network_dd_fractional.csv
are byte-identical to the un-armed posture, so the WIRE and every solve artefact are unchanged and
the goldens in config/golden/ are untouched (the golden re-base is still DEFERRED).
THE BASELINE PAIR THIS RE-BASES TO IS runs/_rf0hv2_field6 (NOT _rfpdfix_field6_both and NOT
_alc_field6 any more): consumer p50 by hour 0.43 / 0.16 / 0.31 / 0.49 / 0.68 / 0.49 m (p90 3.11 /
106 level trips (27 wl / 79 if) over 1145 checks.  Exe gnss_processor_rf0hv2.exe sha256[:16]
A3D62A242C04E545, source main e437b6b.  It reproduces the pre-ALC-ARC _alc_field6 byte for byte,
products.txt and every consumer trace included; only the level-check coverage moved, 0.204 -> 0.197.
amb_level_check_restart is NOT set here -- it stays at the loader default 'all' (card ALC's rule).
The 'inconsistent' policy was built and measured on this posture (docs/refound/
ALC2_restart_policy_adoption_2026-09-19.md, runs/_alc2_field6): it raises the check's coverage
0.204 -> 0.300 with translate-caused restarts 0, and the consumer LOSES 0.43 / 0.41 / -0.02 / 0.25 /
-- so it is REFUSED, not adopted.
2026-09-20 (card PBH, docs/refound/PBH_phase_bias_hold_2026-09-19.md): the PHASE-BIAS HOLD is ADOPTED at the
author's instruction -- network.emit_pb_hold: true, with closed_loop.pb_step_translate: false (the hold IS the
zero-dead-band translation, moved to the producer) and closed_loop.amb_level_check: false (harmful under the
hold: five of six hours worse on both beds).  The baseline pair is now runs/_rf0hv3_{field,sim}6 (= the PBH-1
arm H byte for byte), exe gnss_processor_pbh1.exe F1D3BDDB...  Every add-back is a delta against that pair.
2026-09-20 (card AB2 sections 10 to 13, docs/refound/AB2_l5_third_frequency_2026-09-20.md): the GAP RE-ENTRY
RESPONSE is ARMED at the author's instruction -- network.cycle_slip.gap_reentry_relevel: true.  The working bases
folded 41 shifted-and-bridged arcs in 6 h on the field (standing invariant 1 open); armed, T4_attrib 457 to 228 and
the clock wire on the consumer's satellites 0.0274 to 0.0107 m; on the sim it is neutral without losses of lock and
restores the base level under 81 injected ones (0.45 to 0.05 m).  The baseline pair is now runs/_rf0hv4_{field,sim}6.
STILL OPEN: the re-entry is seen per SATELLITE, so a loss of lock on the primary pair while band 5 or a fallback
signal tracks through is not seen (card GRS, docs/refound/GRS_gap_reentry_per_signal_2026-09-20.md).
2026-09-20 (cards GRS and CSL, docs/refound/): TWO MORE KNOBS ARMED at the author's instruction --
network.cycle_slip.gap_reentry_per_signal: true (the re-entry seen per SIGNAL: a loss of lock on the primary pair while
band 5 or a fallback signal tracks through; sim fault repaired completely, field T4_attrib 228 to 92, 12 h arm passed) and
processing.canonical_signal_rule: priority (the first-epoch satellite count latched L1C at 47 stations although 18 carry
L1W; with the priority-first signal the field consumer goes from 162 to 603 epochs below a decimetre of 720 and from 275 to
994 of 1440 in 12 h; byte-identical on the sim; the closed-loop consumer stays on count).  The baseline pair is now
runs/_rf0hv5_{field,sim}6, exe gnss_processor_csl.exe.  OPEN: the mechanism of the latch effect is half read (a station
subset, card CSL section 4); network.canonical_pair_admission is KEEP_OFF (card CPA).
2026-09-22 (card EV7, docs/refound/EV7_all_sat_clock_decouple_2026-09-21.md): ONE MORE KNOB ARMED at the author's instruction --
network.phase_datum_gate_drop_erase: true.  DEFECT of the coverage gate on the float vehicle: when phase_datum_min_stations removes a
(satellite, signal) phase-bias column with one tracker left, that station's CARRIED ambiguity stayed defined against the removed column and
absorbed the whole bias in one epoch (metres against a centimetre prior); 13 such edges in 6 h carried 49 of the field run's 50 clock-anchor
trips and every all-satellite decouple.  Armed, the drop edge erases the family's carries before assembly, as the return edge always did:
trips 50 to 1, clock wire 0.0184 / 0.0107 to 0.0091 / 0.0072 m, census 13 of 16 sites better, 12 h trips 134 to 8; byte-identical on the sim
(no such edge there).  The baseline pair is now runs/_rf0hv6_{field,sim}6, exe gnss_processor_ev7.exe.  OPEN: the consumers' standing Up offset.
2026-09-22 (cards UPO and SCC, docs/refound/): TWO MORE KNOBS ARMED at the author's instruction --
network.station_marker_to_arp: true (DEFECT: the roster was held at its ITRF2020 MONUMENT coordinates while the observations refer to the
antenna; 48 of 59 field stations carry an eccentricity, GRAZ00AUT 1.964 m; a station's zenith wet delay absorbed a quarter of it and the
satellite clocks the rest, regionally: WTZZ00DEU's standing Up offset of -0.085 m.  Armed: 0.52 0.04 0.01 0.01 0.02 0.01 m by hour, mean Up
zero from hour 4, clock wire 0.0091 / 0.0072 to 0.0069 / 0.0034 m, 12 h 875 to 1046 epochs below a decimetre; an exact no-op on the sim, whose
stations have no eccentricity) and network.second_code_channel: true with network.second_code_sigma_scale: 10 (a station contributes every
band-1 code it tracks as code-only rows through a receiver inter-signal state: census hour 1 better by a median of 0.136 m, code-bias dropouts
50 to 4, QUIN00USA's excursion gone; it costs WTZZ00DEU about 0.02 m from hour 3 and FAILS card SCC's frozen bar B1: armed as the author's
decision, every frequency and every channel being the plan).  The baseline pair is now runs/_rf0hv7_{field,sim}6, exe gnss_processor_rf7.exe.
OPEN: site-specific census offsets, the pinned pair's standing code misfit, the consumer's elevation mask, the goldens' monument roster.
2026-09-22 (card SCU, docs/refound/SCU_station_coordinates_unknowns_2026-09-22.md): MIZU00JPN DROPPED from the roster at the author's
instruction (58 stations).  Its configured coordinate is 1.6 m from where its data puts it (E +1.47, N -0.64, U -0.12 m; the ITRF2020
resolver applies no post-seismic model) and that one station carried a third of the all-satellite clock error (clock wire 0.0068 to
0.0045 m).  A coordinate number derived from this network's own solution is deliberately NOT put into the roster.  The constrained
coordinate states of card SCU are deferred by the author until the network works; the station-congruence table and the roster audit
(runs/_msc/scripts/msc_roster_audit.py) are the detection instruments until then.  Field baseline: runs/_rf0hv8_field6, exe
gnss_processor_rf7.exe; the sim base is untouched (baseline runs/_rf0hv7_sim6).
2026-09-22 (card GRK, docs/refound/GRK_gap_reentry_key_mismatch_2026-09-22.md): ONE MORE KNOB ARMED at the author's instruction --
network.cycle_slip.tracker_modeled_first: true.  DEFECT: the arc-level slip tracker named a band by the lexically lowest phase with a
matching code (L1C before L1W) while the carried ambiguity at an L1W station is keyed L1W, so the row-level gap re-entry response looked the
carry up under the wrong key at all 18 L1W stations (band 2 at 28 stations) and the band-1 carry folded across every break there (0 of 31
answered).  Armed, the tracker names each band by the station's LATCHED phase: unreachable re-entries 21 to 0, gross post-fit code rows
at full weight 507 to 101 (12 h 759 to 261), consumer, census and clock wire unchanged; byte-identical on the sim (one signal per band).
Field baseline: runs/_rf0hv9_field6, exe gnss_processor_grk4.exe; the sim is byte-identical (baseline runs/_rf0hv9_sim6 = runs/_rf0hv7_sim6).
This knob is phase 2 of card SID (the tracker reads the signal roster) and is superseded by it when the roster lands.
2026-09-22 (card RF-3, docs/refound/RF-3_code_row_qc_2026-09-22.md): THE GROSS LINE-OF-SIGHT SCREEN ARMED at the author's instruction --
network.gross_los_screen: true with network.gross_los_min_rows_rule: available and network.gross_los_emit_exclude: true (the other
gross_los_* knobs at their loader defaults; gross_los_bound FALSIFIED and OFF, gross_los_station_tier OFF, gross_los_sat_standdown OFF).
DEFECT CLASS: on the float vehicle the gross post-fit code rows are the slip response's own re-coupling edge (a drop restores a stale,
stiff variance), and the only acting code-row tier could not reach a line of sight whose station had lost every code signal but one
(the fixed two-row bar) and landed its response one epoch after the emission.  Armed: rows above 3 m at full weight 394 to 213, above
10 m 100 to 32, T4_attrib 81 to 53, 7 declarations / 5 releases / 2 expiries, the first changed emission at the declaring epoch;
WTZZ00DEU 0.560 0.059 0.028 0.030 0.036 0.045 to 0.560 0.059 0.028 0.030 0.039 0.048 m by hour (611 epochs below a decimetre unchanged),
clock wire 0.0045 / 0.0028 to 0.0041 / 0.0028 m; census of 16 sites flat to a millimetre, counts 5 better and none worse, absolute mean
Up smaller at 10 of 16.  Byte-identical on the sim (2 LOS-epochs over the bar, none persisted).  The RF-3a drop floor
(network.amb_float_drop_var_m2) stays built and OFF: it removes the walk but costs hour 1, a trade the census does not decide.
Baseline pair: runs/_rf0hv10_{field,sim}6, exe gnss_processor_rf3b.exe (the field wire byte-identical to runs/_rap_rf3b_gl_nobound).
